mapper.select: SELECT o.OPP_ID AS "opportunityId",o.OPP_NM AS "opportunityName", o.CUST_CLNT_ID AS "customerId",c.CLNT_NM AS "customerName",o.SALES_STEP_CD AS "stageCode", o.WIN_PRBL_RT AS "winningProbability",o.EXPCT_AMT AS "expectedAmount", to_char(to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM'),'YYYY-MM') AS "startMonth", o.NEXT_TODO_CN AS "nextAction",o.NEXT_TODO_DDLN_DT AS "nextActionDueDate", o.APRV_STAT_CD AS "approvalStatusCode",COALESCE(o.MOD_DTTM,o.REG_DTTM) AS "modifiedAt", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(n.NEED_CNT*n.MON_MM) FROM TB_SL_OPP_NEED n WHERE n.OPP_ID=o.OPP_ID),0) AS "manpower" FROM TB_SL_OPP o JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=o.CUST_CLNT_ID WHERE o.OPP_STAT_CD='ING' ORDER BY COALESCE(o.MOD_DTTM,o.REG_DTTM) DESC,o.OPP_ID

SELECT n.OPP_ID AS "opportunityId",n.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",COALESCE(MAX(c.CODE_NM),n.JOB_CD) AS "jobName", SUM(n.NEED_CNT)::int AS "headcount" FROM TB_SL_OPP_NEED n JOIN TB_SL_OPP o ON o.OPP_ID=n.OPP_ID AND o.OPP_STAT_CD='ING' LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND c.CODE=n.JOB_CD GROUP BY n.OPP_ID,n.JOB_CD ORDER BY n.OPP_ID,MIN(n.NEED_SN)
SELECT c.CODE AS "jobCode",c.CODE_NM AS "jobName" FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND c.DEL_YN='N' ORDER BY c.SORT_ORD,c.CODE

SELECT o.OPP_ID AS "opportunityId",o.OPP_NM AS "opportunityName",c.CLNT_NM AS "customerName", o.OPP_STAT_CD AS "result",o.EXPCT_AMT AS "expectedAmount",o.RSLT_DT AS "resultDate", CASE WHEN o.OPP_STAT_CD='WIN' THEN o.PROJ_ID END AS "projectId", CASE WHEN o.OPP_STAT_CD='LOSE' THEN concat_ws(' · ',r.CODE_NM,o.LOSE_MEMO) END AS "lossReason" FROM TB_SL_OPP o JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=o.CUST_CLNT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE r ON r.CODE_GRP_ID='LOSE_RSN' AND r.CODE=o.LOSE_RSN_CD WHERE o.OPP_STAT_CD IN ('WIN','LOSE','STOP') AND o.OPP_STAT_CD=#{result} ORDER BY o.RSLT_DT DESC,o.OPP_ID
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM TB_SL_OPP o JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=o.CUST_CLNT_ID WHERE o.OPP_STAT_CD IN ('WIN','LOSE')
mapper.sql: w(ym,first_day,last_day) AS (VALUES (CAST(#{m.month} AS varchar),CAST(#{m.firstDay} AS date),CAST(#{m.lastDay} AS date)))

d.USE_YN='Y' AND d.DRCT_CLS_CD='DRCT' AND (d.JNCMP_DT IS NULL OR d.JNCMP_DT <= w.last_day) AND (d.RETIRE_DT IS NULL OR d.RETIRE_DT >= w.first_day) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT s WHERE s.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND s.WORK_STAT_CD='LEAVE' AND s.BGN_DT <= w.last_day AND (s.END_DT IS NULL OR s.END_DT >= w.first_day))
mapper.select: WITH SELECT w.ym AS "month", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.APLY_UPRC*m.MON_MM) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=m.PROJ_ID WHERE m.INPUT_YM=w.ym AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' AND a.INPUT_TYPE_CD!='FREE' AND p.PROJ_STAT_CD='ING' AND p.CTRT_TYPE_CD IN ('MO','DP') AND a.INPUT_BGN_DT <= w.last_day AND a.INPUT_END_DT >= w.first_day),0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(GREATEST(0,p.CTRT_AMT-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(b.SPLY_AMT) FROM TB_BL_BILL b WHERE b.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND b.CNCL_YN='N'),0)) / NULLIF((extract(year FROM p.CTRT_END_DT)::int-extract(year FROM CAST(#{horizonStart} AS date))::int)*12 +extract(month FROM p.CTRT_END_DT)::int-extract(month FROM CAST(#{horizonStart} AS date))::int+1,0)) FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p WHERE p.PROJ_STAT_CD='ING' AND p.CTRT_TYPE_CD='TK' AND p.CTRT_END_DT >= w.first_day AND p.CTRT_BGN_DT <= w.last_day),0) AS "projectRevenue", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.EXPCT_AMT/COALESCE(o.EXPCT_PRD_MCNT,6)*o.WIN_PRBL_RT/100) FROM TB_SL_OPP o WHERE o.OPP_STAT_CD='ING' AND to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM') <= w.first_day AND to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM')+make_interval(months => COALESCE(o.EXPCT_PRD_MCNT,6)::int) > w.first_day),0) AS "weightedOpportunityRevenue", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.EXPCT_AMT/COALESCE(o.EXPCT_PRD_MCNT,6)) FROM TB_SL_OPP o WHERE o.OPP_STAT_CD='ING' AND to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM') <= w.first_day AND to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM')+make_interval(months => COALESCE(o.EXPCT_PRD_MCNT,6)::int) > w.first_day),0) AS "opportunityRevenue" FROM w ORDER BY w.ym

WITH SELECT o.OPP_ID AS "opportunityId",o.OPP_NM AS "opportunityName",o.WIN_PRBL_RT AS "winningProbability",w.ym AS "month", o.EXPCT_AMT/COALESCE(o.EXPCT_PRD_MCNT,6)*o.WIN_PRBL_RT/100 AS "weightedRevenue" FROM w JOIN TB_SL_OPP o ON o.OPP_STAT_CD='ING' AND to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM') <= w.first_day AND to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM')+make_interval(months => COALESCE(o.EXPCT_PRD_MCNT,6)::int) > w.first_day ORDER BY COALESCE(o.MOD_DTTM,o.REG_DTTM) DESC,o.OPP_ID,w.ym

WITH , confirmed AS ( SELECT m.DEV_ID,m.INPUT_YM,SUM(m.MON_MM) AS mm FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' WHERE m.INPUT_YM IN (SELECT ym FROM w) GROUP BY m.DEV_ID,m.INPUT_YM ) SELECT w.ym AS "month",d.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",d.DEV_ID AS "developerId",COALESCE(c.mm,0) AS "confirmedMm" FROM w JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON LEFT JOIN confirmed c ON c.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND c.INPUT_YM=w.ym ORDER BY w.ym,d.JOB_CD,d.DEV_ID

WITH SELECT w.ym AS "month",d.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",d.DEV_ID AS "developerId",COALESCE((SELECT h.NEW_CTRT_MM FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST h WHERE h.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND h.ASGN_CHG_TYPE_CD IN ('INPUT','RATE') AND h.NEW_CTRT_MM IS NOT NULL AND to_char(h.APLY_DT,'YYYYMM') <= to_char(a.INPUT_END_DT,'YYYYMM') ORDER BY h.APLY_DT DESC,h.HIST_SN DESC LIMIT 1),a.CTRT_MM) AS "monthlyMm", a.EXT_PSBL_CD AS "extensionPossibilityCode" FROM w JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' AND a.INPUT_END_DT < w.first_day ORDER BY w.ym,d.JOB_CD,d.DEV_ID,a.ASGN_ID

WITH SELECT w.ym AS "month",n.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",n.NEED_CNT AS "requiredCount",n.MON_MM AS "monthlyMm", o.WIN_PRBL_RT AS "winningProbability" FROM w JOIN TB_SL_OPP_NEED n ON to_date(n.BGN_YM,'YYYYMM') <= w.first_day AND to_date(n.BGN_YM,'YYYYMM')+make_interval(months => n.PRD_MCNT::int) > w.first_day JOIN TB_SL_OPP o ON o.OPP_ID=n.OPP_ID AND o.OPP_STAT_CD='ING' ORDER BY w.ym,n.JOB_CD,n.OPP_ID,n.NEED_SN

WITH , plans AS ( SELECT n.PROJ_ID,n.JOB_CD,n.PLAN_MM,p.CTRT_BGN_DT,p.CTRT_END_DT, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.MON_MM) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' WHERE m.PROJ_ID=n.PROJ_ID AND a.JOB_CD=n.JOB_CD),0) AS confirmed_mm FROM TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN n JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=n.PROJ_ID WHERE p.PROJ_STAT_CD='ING' AND p.CTRT_TYPE_CD!='IN' ) SELECT w.ym AS "month",n.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",n.PLAN_MM AS "plannedMm",n.confirmed_mm AS "confirmedMm", ((extract(year FROM n.CTRT_END_DT)::int-extract(year FROM CAST(#{horizonStart} AS date))::int)*12 +extract(month FROM n.CTRT_END_DT)::int-extract(month FROM CAST(#{horizonStart} AS date))::int+1) AS "remainingMonths" FROM w JOIN plans n ON n.CTRT_BGN_DT <= w.last_day AND n.CTRT_END_DT >= w.first_day ORDER BY w.ym,n.JOB_CD,n.PROJ_ID
SELECT c.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",COUNT(*)::int AS "candidateCount" FROM TB_HR_CAND c WHERE c.CNTC_STAT_CD NOT IN ('HOLD','CTRT') GROUP BY c.JOB_CD ORDER BY c.JOB_CD
